stem: Which medication is commonly used to manage aggressive behaviour in children with autism when behavioural strategies alone are not enough?
explanation: Risperidone is the medication commonly used to manage aggression in children with autism when behavioural support is insufficient.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because methylphenidate is used for attention and hyperactivity symptoms, not primarily aggression
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because fluoxetine is used for anxiety or obsessive symptoms, not first-line for aggressive behaviour
optionExplanations.C: Correct because risperidone is commonly used to reduce aggressive behaviour in children with autism when behavioural approaches are not enough
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because clonidine is more often used for sleep or hyperarousal symptoms
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because aripiprazole can also be used for irritability in autism, but it is not the option identified in this question

source.hint: Look for the drug often used when behavioral plans are insufficient to control aggression.
